name: mcp-acl-list
description:
MCP ACL List policy controls access to tools, resources, and prompts using
mode and exceptions. It filters list responses based on the configured mode
and enforces the same allow/deny rules on request paths. This policy does not
rewrite capability fields (tools, resources, or prompts) or modify list entry contents.

- Missing capability config: Allow all capabilities of that type
- mode: allow, exceptions: [..] => allow all except listed exceptions
- mode: deny, exceptions: [..] => deny all except listed exceptions

On a gateway with an MCP operation resolver, it identifies the capability from the mirrored Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name headers on MCP 2026-07-28 and from the resolver's facts on earlier revisions; on a gateway without one, it reads the request body itself for every request. A capability it cannot identify is not governed; a modern request missing a required Mcp-Method or Mcp-Name header is rejected, and on a gateway with a resolver, a request body the gateway could not read is rejected.
